AudioDuplicate.WindowTitle: GF Music Manager · Review audio warnings
AudioDuplicate.Heading: Review audio warnings
AudioDuplicate.Description:
Some audio sources need your review. Uncheck only the sources you do not need.
The original mods will not be changed.
AudioDuplicate.Empty: There are no warnings of this type.
AudioDuplicate.Batch.Label: Batch actions:
AudioDuplicate.Batch.Prefer.ContentToolt: For every content-match group, include only the source from the highest-priority mod
AudioDuplicate.Batch.AdoptAll.ContentToo: Include every source in all content-match groups
AudioDuplicate.Batch.ExcludeAll.ContentT: Exclude every source in all content-match groups
AudioDuplicate.Batch.Prefer.SimilarToolt: For every similar-candidate group, include only the source from the highest-priority mod
AudioDuplicate.Batch.AdoptAll.SimilarToo: Include every source in all similar-candidate groups
AudioDuplicate.Batch.ExcludeAll.SimilarT: Exclude every source in all similar-candidate groups
AudioDuplicate.Page.PathConflict:
Multiple audio sources use the same in-game path.
GF Music Manager avoids the conflict so each source can be included. Uncheck only the sources you do not need.
AudioDuplicate.Page.ContentMatch:
The in-game paths differ, but these audio sources have exactly the same content.
You can keep both. To reduce duplicates, select the sources you want to keep.
AudioDuplicate.Page.Similar:
The in-game paths differ, but these audio sources have nearly the same content.
They may be different versions of the same track, so preview them and confirm which sources to keep.
AudioDuplicate.Detection.PathConflict: Detection: normalized in-game audio paths are compared
AudioDuplicate.Detection.ContentMatch: Detection: the SHA-256 hashes of the complete audio files match
AudioDuplicate.Detection.Similar:
Similarity comparison reduces the effects of volume differences and leading or trailing silence.
Because this is not an exact match, sources are not excluded automatically.
